title: From Legacy to Contemporary: Scalable Color Modernization for Long Videos
title_zh: 从复古到现代：长视频的可扩展色彩现代化

paragraphs.en: 总结：研究者提出无需训练的可扩展框架，利用文本引导图像编辑模型为长视频老片进行色彩现代化，提升观感并保持时序一致性。 Bringing legacy video back to contemporary screens does not necessarily make it look contemporary. Earlier imaging pipelines often leave color casts, muted chroma, weak con- trast, and tonal imbalance, while correcting these character- istics still relies heavily on expert colorists and scales poorly to long, multi-shot videos. We formulate long video color modernization, a task that updates the chromatic and tonal appearance of legacy color footage while preserving scene content and coherence across frames and shots. We introduce a scalable, training-free framework that jointly modernizes grids of temporally adjacent keyframes using a pretrained text-guided image editing model, producing coherent con- temporary references without paired supervision. Compact shot-specific color transforms then propagate these adjust- ments throughout each shot, preserving spatial structure and temporal stability. We conduct a multidimensional evaluation on diverse legacy videos spanning five decades. We combine a human evaluation of perceived modernness with quantita- tive measures of content fidelity, temporal stability, percep- tual quality, and efficiency, and introduce Source-Weighted Inter-shot Grade Consistency (SW-IGC) to assess grade co- herence across shots. On our evaluation set, our frame- work achieves the highest perceived modernness while re- maining competitive across complementary measures, open- ing a path toward the systematic study of long video color modernization. Code is available at https://github.com/jiwoomood/ Video_Color_Modernization.git
paragraphs.zh: 总结：研究者提出无需训练的可扩展框架，利用文本引导图像编辑模型为长视频老片进行色彩现代化，提升观感并保持时序一致性。将老视频重新带回当代屏幕，并不一定使其看起来具有当代感。 早期的影像处理流程常常留下偏色、色彩暗淡、对比度弱和影调失衡等问题，而矫正这些特性仍然严重依赖专业调色师，且难以扩展到长篇多镜头视频。 我们提出了长视频色彩现代化这一任务，即在保持场景内容以及帧与镜头之间连贯性的同时，更新老式彩色影像的色彩与影调外观。 我们引入了一个可扩展的、无需训练的框架，利用预训练的文本引导图像编辑模型，对时序上相邻的关键帧网格进行联合现代化处理，在无需配对监督的情况下生成连贯的当代参考画面。 随后，紧凑的针对特定镜头的色彩变换将这些调整传播到整个镜头中，保持空间结构和时序稳定性。 我们在跨越五个年代、多种多样的老视频上进行了多维度评估。 我们将感知现代感的人类评估与内容保真度、时序稳定性、感知质量和效率的定量指标相结合，并提出了源加权镜头间调色一致性（SW-IGC）来评估跨镜头的调色连贯性。 在我们的评估集上，该框架获得了最高的感知现代感，同时在互补指标上保持竞争力，为长视频色彩现代化的系统性研究开辟了一条道路。 代码已发布于 https://github.com/jiwoomood/Video_Color_Modernization.git
